summary: Marti Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing management's discussion and analysis and unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings update by a foreign private issuer. The company voluntarily elected to begin publishing quarterly financial information in 2026. No mention of any special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change. The filing contains only standard financial disclosures and forward-looking statements. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are discussed.
